cases.exposure_context_quote: All exposures were intentional ingestions occurring in rural settings, frequently associated with alcohol consumption.
cases.agent_quote: This retrospective observational study included eight consecutive patients managed for suspected acute 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid (2,4-D) poisoning at a tertiary-care rural teaching hospital in Central India over an 18-month period.
cases.circumstance: Intentional ingestion; estimated ingested volume ∼250; time from ingestion to hospital 3 h; comorbidities and alcohol co-ingestion not specified per case.

symptoms.quote: All non-survivors presented with hypotension and metabolic acidosis on admission, whereas none of the survivors demonstrated early hemodynamic compromise.

cases.outcome_quote: Overall, 4/8 (50%) patients required vasopressor support, 2/8 (25%) required dialysis, and 4/8 (50%) died.
cases.notes: Per Table 1: hypotension on admission Yes; CNS depression Yes; severe metabolic acidosis Yes; rhabdomyolysis Yes (CPK 6895 IU/L); AKI Yes; cardiac involvement No; dialysis Yes; urinary alkalinization Yes; hospital stay 4 days; time to death 4 days. Individual sex, symptom quotes, and lab values beyond CPK for cases 1 and 5 not provided per case in the text.
